hook: Stomach feeling sluggish before you've even had breakfast? Grandma swore by one simple morning drink.
remedy: As old-fashioned home wisdom, sipping warm water with fresh lemon first thing in the morning has long been a favorite ritual for feeling a little lighter and more settled before the day gets going.
steps: Squeeze half a lemon into a mug of warm water
Sip it slowly on an empty stomach, first thing in the morning
caution: The acidity can wear on tooth enamel over time, so rinse your mouth with plain water afterward, and skip it if you have acid reflux.
cta: Follow along for more old-school home remedies
